title: ATLAS Vercel project-link registry entry
description: Tracked, source-owned expected Vercel project identity for one repo_id. This is the *expected* identity a local .vercel/project.json (the *observed* machine binding, in Vercel's own camelCase projectId/orgId/projectName shape -- NOT this schema) must match before ops/atlas/vercel_hobby_guardrail_report.py will trust it. team_id must be the canonical Vercel team ID (the orgId field of a real linked .vercel/project.json), not the human-readable team slug -- the two are different values and only team_id participates in the observed/expected comparison. Lives under docs/registry/vercel-project-links/<repo_id>.json -- NOT under data/**, which is gitignored and would never survive a fresh clone or hosted CI checkout.

repo_id.description: Must match the filename stem, e.g. fitness.json has repo_id: "fitness".

team_id.description: The canonical Vercel team ID -- this is what a linked checkout's .vercel/project.json reports as orgId. A team slug (e.g. "fawxzzy") is NOT a valid value here and will never match a real orgId.

team_slug.description: Optional, audit-only human-readable team slug. Never compared against orgId; present only for readability.
